title: In-game feedback: the `meta` part of POST /api/feedback
description: GH-464. Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-08-in-game-feedback-design.md ("Server contract as built"). The Worker's twin is packages/worker/src/feedback-meta.ts, pinned to this file by feedback-meta.test.ts. Rules a JSON Schema cannot state, enforced by the Worker: `context` serialises to at most 8192 UTF-8 bytes; the `meta` part is at most 24 KB; `text` is not whitespace-only for the five form kinds; the multipart `shot` part (image/webp ONLY, magic bytes checked) is accepted only with source `pause`, and one over 64 KB is dropped while the note is still stored (201 with dropped.picture = too_large); the `replay` part (a JSON object, <= 96 KB) only with source `pause` and category `bug`; the whole body is <= 448 KB.

context.description: Free-form §4.1 context, shown as a key/value table in /stats/feedback. Keys the issue builder reads when present: renderer, quality, gpu (strings), viewport ([w, h]), dpr (number), locale (string). At most 8192 bytes serialised.
